description: Create many components in one call: each item names its type (bus, generator, load, link, storage_unit, carrier) and its fields; any other key is set as a static attribute. Buses need latitude and longitude; generators, loads and storage units take their bus's position unless given one. Carriers, then buses, then the rest are created in order, so references resolve; a line is a link with p_nom. PROCESS is read-only here.

attributes.description: Static attributes to set after creation (any name).

name: create_components_batch
